tweetText: OpenAI is adding new safety features and parental controls to ChatGPT for teenagers. These tools help ensure young users have a secure and helpful experience. via OpenAI News
Google Vids now lets you create videos using a digital AI avatar of yourself. This makes it easy for anyone to produce professional-looking video content using simple prompts. via TechCrunch AI
Roblox added a new feature that lets users create basic games using text prompts on mobile. This makes game development accessible to everyone, regardless of coding skills. via TechCrunch AI
Google’s AI Mode can now connect and interact with your favorite apps. This allows the AI to complete actual tasks instead of just answering questions. via TechCrunch AI
DoorDash launched a command-line tool that lets users and AI agents order food directly from a terminal. This makes it easier for AI to interact with real-world services. via TechCrunch AI
OpenAI released its first piece of hardware this week. This marks the company's first move into physical devices. via TechCrunch AI
A former DeepMind researcher raised a $300M valuation before even launching a product. This highlights the massive investor hype surrounding the next frontier of visual AI. via TechCrunch AI

AMI Labs CEO Alexandre LeBrun refuses to call his AI superintelligence or AGI. This highlights a growing debate over whether current AI models are truly approaching human-level intelligence. via TechCrunch AI
Moonshot is developing Kimi K3, a massive AI model with up to 3 trillion parameters. This could make China a major competitor to top US models. via TechCrunch AI
Apple is partnering with Alibaba and Baidu to bring its AI features to China. This move helps Apple expand its artificial intelligence presence in a critical market. via TechCrunch AI
